title: Natural Language Generation from Visual Events: State-of-the-Art and Key Open Questions
abstract: arXiv:2502.13034v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In recent years, a substantial body of work in visually grounded natural language processing has focused on real-life multimodal scenarios such as describing content depicted in images or videos. However, comparatively less attention has been devoted to studying the nature and degree of interaction between the different modalities in these scenarios. In this paper, we argue that any task dealing with natural language generation from sequences of images or frames is an instance of the broader, more general problem of modeling the intricate relationships between visual events unfolding over time and the features of the language used to interpret, describe, or narrate them. Therefore, solving these tasks requires models to be capable of identifying and managing such intricacies. translated_title: 从视觉事件生成自然语言：研究现状与关键开放性问题
translated_abstract: 近年来，视觉接地自然语言处理领域的大量研究工作集中在真实生活的多模态场景上，例如描述图像或视频中所呈现的内容。然而，相对而言，针对这些场景中不同模态之间交互的性质与程度的研究所获得的关注较少。在本文中，我们认为任何处理从图像序列或帧序列生成自然语言的任务，都是一个更宽泛、更普遍问题的实例，即建模随时间展开的视觉事件与用于解释、描述或叙述这些事件的语言特征之间复杂关系的问题。因此，解决这些任务要求模型能够识别并处理此类复杂性。我们考虑了五个看似不同的任务，并论证它们是这一更广泛的多模态问题的典型实例。随后，我们调研了代表性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将从图像/帧序列生成自然语言的各类任务统一视为建模随时间展开的视觉事件与语言特征之间复杂关系的更广泛多模态问题的实例，并综述了五个相关任务的研究现状及关键开放性问题。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that any natural language generation task from image or frame sequences is an instance of the broader multimodal problem of modeling the intricate relationships between visual events unfolding over time and language, surveying five representative tasks and key open questions.
